decisions.reason: The materials management module extends the core practice-management software at low marginal cost, and an established firm with growing industry turnover has the slack to carry it while results are still forming, so there is no performance shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.

The KIM secure messaging service is a regulatory telematics requirement for German dental practices and is actively updated (KIM 1.5), making it core to meeting customer and compliance aspirations rather than a candidate for divestment.
